retained_foundations.content: Smooth compact approximate identities on finite-dimensional Lie groups; Haar invariance and compact-group averaging; differentiation of compactly supported integrals; partitions of unity and local submanifold charts; finite-dimensional exterior algebra. Exact kernel reproduction, every derivative estimate, and both noncommutative adjugate identities are proved here.

Schur's lemma and finite-dimensional compact isotypic decomposition, as in the inherited DC construction. The full multiplicity-one lowest isotypic space is inherited from the proved DC9--DC10, not assumed from a Bessel uniqueness theorem.
Full EvalPStatement, EvalMStatement, QuotPStatement and QuotMStatement with all original data, exclusions and operator periods. Used only by the explicitly conditional BST11.
